focus_areas: Texture fidelity of the terry cloth material

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the embroidered details on the white bib. AI models often fail to render coherent small-scale patterns or text-like symbols in embroidery, resulting in gibberish shapes. Verify if the motifs are distinct objects or just colored blobs. Also, check the shadow cast by the folded neck strap; it should be consistent with the light source direction indicated by the rest of the scene.
image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of two baby bibs resting on a textured beige carpet. The primary subject is a white fabric bib with a curved neck opening and a decorative embroidered panel featuring small colorful motifs (possibly animals or shapes). A second bib, red with a busy pattern of cartoon dinosaurs and vehicles, is partially visible in the bottom right corner. The lighting is bright, casting soft shadows, highlighting the texture of the white terry cloth or cotton material.

expert_testimonies.reason: To ensure the bib sits naturally on the carpet with correct contact shadows and no unnatural bleeding into the background texture.
To confirm the object is indeed a bib and distinguish it from similar items like napkins or clothing patches.
To verify the continuity of the fabric edges and ensure the embroidered panel is properly integrated into the main body without floating artifacts.
To assess the realism of the fabric textures (terry cloth vs. carpet) and check for subtle generative noise or blurring inconsistencies.
